title: Campaign Builder
subtitle: Turning repeated campaign production into one reusable creative system.

evidence.statement: ~10-minute final variation setup once imagery is ready
Access for more users and a Contentstack API connection

quickView.problem: Multi-channel campaigns required many separate artboards, repeated changes, and manually organized handoffs.
quickView.evolution: Separate artboards → Figma system → reusable campaign-building workflow
quickView.product: A reusable system separating campaign-specific content from shared template rules.
quickView.impact: The working estimate is an approximately 75% production-time reduction.
quickView.learning: A design system can standardize the work without actually fixing the workflow.
